title: Device battery notifications should be critical
line: Low battery notifications for a mouse, keyboard or headset now stay on screen until you close them or the device is recharged.
explanation: PowerDevil sent the peripheral low battery notification through a fire-and-forget KNotification::event() call with CloseOnTimeout and normal urgency, so it disappeared after a few seconds, unlike the laptop battery notifications which are persistent and critical. The change creates the 'lowperipheralbattery' notification as a persistent, critical KNotification, keeps one per device, and closes it when that device's charge rises above the low level again. The now unused Core::emitNotification() helper is removed.

commits.message:
daemon: keep low battery notifications for peripherals until recharged

Notifications about a low mouse, keyboard or headset battery closed by
themselves after a few seconds and were easy to miss. Show them as critical
persistent notifications instead, and close them once the device recharges.

BUG: 447644

media.caption: Master: mouse battery drops to 8%, notification appears with a timeout bar
Master: 25 seconds later the notification is gone
Fix: the notification is shown as critical, without a timeout
Fix: still on screen 40 seconds later
